text: At 2.1.20 M33 `ywud56l6` (and `m33l11sc`) say the tests of a built-in envelope use the host repo's internal, unpublished test setup and that the `…/plugin-testing` harness is an intent, not a contract; the unit goal retires the published harness. The criterion `ac-test-koperty-wbudowanej-importuje-har` is still `active` at 2.1.20 and its title still requires a built-in envelope test to import the harness from `@inharness-ai/claude4spec/plugin-testing`. The two disagree. Assumed: the page wins. Envelope tests now import `createPluginTestApp` from `@c4s-internal/plugin-test-setup`, a vitest alias (root config + every envelope's config) onto `tests/helpers/plugin-test-setup.ts`; the old test that carried `[ac:ac-test-koperty-wbudowanej-importuje-har]` is rewritten as `[section:ywud56l6]` and no longer carries that slug. The criterion should be deprecated or reworded to the internal setup. (`ac-wyniesienie-koperty-wbudowanej-do-oso` still holds literally: the alias keeps every import in the tests unchanged on extraction.)
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2001 — `ac-test-koperty-wbudowanej-importuje-har` (still active at 2.1.20) names the published `…/plugin-testing` harness; `ywud56l6` at 2.1.20 replaces it with the host repo's internal test setup. The case asserts the page, not that criterion's title, so it does not carry its slug.
